body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes CI link check failures caused by invalid lychee configuration and broken documentation links. The changes ensure the link checker runs successfully by updating the configuration to match lychee v0.21.0 requirements and correcting all broken links found during validation.

**Changes:**
- Fixed `lychee.toml` configuration by changing `verbose` from boolean to string log level
- Added `.lycheecache` to `.gitignore` to exclude lychee's cache directory
- Replaced 6 broken GitHub Discussions links with GitHub Issues (discussions not enabled for this repository)
- Fixed 1 broken example reference from non-existent `task-manager` to existing `todo` example

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| lychee.toml | Updated verbose parameter from `true` to `"info"` to match lychee v0.21.0 string log level requirement |
| .gitignore | Added `.lycheecache` entry to exclude lychee link checker cache directory |
| content/docs/tutorials.mdx | Replaced 2 GitHub Discussions links with GitHub Issues links |
| content/docs/troubleshooting.mdx | Replaced 1 GitHub Discussions link with GitHub Issues link |
| content/docs/specifications/index.mdx | Replaced 1 GitHub Discussions link with GitHub Issues link |
| content/docs/quick-start/build-first-app.mdx | Fixed broken example reference from non-existent `task-manager` to existing `todo` |
| content/docs/faq.mdx | Replaced 1 GitHub Discussions link with GitHub Issues link |
| content/blog/protocol-first-development.mdx | Replaced 1 GitHub Discussions link with GitHub Issues link |
| content/blog/metadata-driven-architecture.mdx | Replaced 1 GitHub Discussions link with GitHub Issues link |
</details>
